experiment.diagnostic_note: targeted four-class diagnostic (578 official test images), explicitly not a full 15-class benchmark

config.diagnostic_note: targeted four-class diagnostic (578 official test images), explicitly not a full 15-class benchmark

diagnostic_class_rationale.transistor: v5 aligned-spatial-style win (ref_spatial P-AP 74.37 vs base 60.31)
diagnostic_class_rationale.zipper: v5 fused-reference loss (ref_plus_base P-AP 75.50 vs base_fuse672 86.72)

normal_reference.selection: sorted paths, evenly spaced indices, first 40 memory then 16 calibration, disjoint
normal_reference.feature_groups: ViTill encoder groups en[0], en[1] at 392
normal_reference.normalization: per-group z-score from memory bank, concat, L2
normal_reference.alignment: per (test image, memory image) coherent shift (sr,sc) in [-2,2]^2; shift score = mean cosine similarity over in-image query positions minus 0.005*(|sr|+|sc|); candidates = +/-1 neighbourhood around the shifted coordinate; out-of-image positions masked; row falls back to the original zero-shift neighbourhood when fewer than top-3 finite candidates remain
normal_reference.matching: batched GEMM; free all patches (unchanged); per-(test image, memory image) coherent shift in [-2,2]^2 selected by mean similarity minus 0.005 Manhattan prior; +/-1 local tolerance around the shifted coordinate; out-of-image masked; zero-shift fallback for rows with fewer than top-k finite candidates

calibration.source: 16 disjoint train/good calibration normals per class
calibration.used_for: fusion variants only; standalone reference maps stay raw

gate.source: calibration normals only; aligned spatial branch
gate.formula: g = 0.15 + 0.35 * exp(-max(rel_extra, 0) / 0.25), clipped to [0.15, 0.50]; rel_extra = median((d_aligned - d_free) / max(d_free, 0.02)) over calibration normals
gate.interpretation: higher relative extra distance lowers the spatial weight; bounded fixed formula, no hard-coded class weights, no test labels

variants.name: ref_spatial_aligned
variants.definition: raw aligned spatial normal-reference map: 1 - mean top-3 cosine sim around the per-(test image, memory image) coherent shift selected in [-2,2]^2, +/-1 local tolerance

variants.name: ref_adaptive_aligned
variants.definition: (1-g) * calib(ref_free) + g * calib(ref_spatial_aligned); g from aligned calibration normals with the exact stage-5 gate

variants.name: aligned_plus_base
variants.definition: 0.5 * calib(base_fuse672) + 0.5 * ref_adaptive_aligned (stage-5 ref_plus_base formula with the aligned branch; PRIMARY)

metrics.mask_source: exact original 448->392 gt transform, nearest to 256
metrics.image_score: original baseline global top1% of the postprocessed 256 map, reused by all variants

identity.image_scores_source: one baseline-global score per test image, reused by every variant
identity.normal_reference_source: train/good only; memory and calibration are disjoint
identity.gate_source: calibration normals only; fixed bounded stage-5 formula applied to the aligned spatial branch
